description: Caravaggio — Colore: Ivory & gold Codice: 5121 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 140.5 cm Rapporto: 64 cm × 94 cm Toni: White The late-16th-century Italian painter CARAVAGGIO’s dramatic and affecting brushwork and scenery ushered in the Baroque style in Europe. The melodrama of CARAVAGGIO is made monumental with feathery plumes and exaggerated flowers that tower over the field of moody color in this fabric. Vivid in design, the striking pattern is a singular work of art.
